$comment: The gaps fork: an issue a seat has just taken. expect: ready, unclear, no-acceptance, needs-decision or too-big. An empty field is sent as (none), as the room sends it.

issue.title: Return 410 for deleted orders
issue.description: GET /orders/:id returns 404 for deleted orders. Return 410 Gone when the order existed and was deleted.
issue.acceptance: GET of a deleted order returns 410; GET of an unknown id still returns 404; tests cover both.

issue.title: Speed up the dashboard
issue.description: The orders widget on the dashboard loads slowly. Cache the totals query.

issue.title: Fix the sync bug
issue.description: Users say sync is broken sometimes.

issue.title: Rebuild the billing system
issue.description: Move billing to the new provider: a new API client, webhook handling, invoice PDFs, the migration of 40,000 customers, and the admin screens.
issue.acceptance: All billing runs on the new provider.

issue.title: Pick the session store
issue.description: Sessions must leave memory. Redis and Postgres both work: Redis is faster, Postgres needs no new service. Someone must choose before the work starts.

issue.title: Add a --dry-run flag to the import command
issue.description: The import command writes to the database. Add --dry-run, which parses and validates the file and prints the counts without writing.
issue.acceptance: --dry-run writes nothing; it prints the rows read, valid and invalid; a new test covers the flag.

issue.title: Clean up the worker's logging
issue.description: Replace the console.log calls in src/worker with the logger and add the job id to each line.

issue.title: Make exports better
issue.description: Exports should be better for big customers.

issue.title: Mobile app v2
issue.description: Build offline mode, push notifications, a new onboarding flow and dark mode for the mobile app.
issue.acceptance: All four ship in the next release.

issue.title: Delete old logs
issue.description: Old logs must be deleted, but legal has not said whether 90 days or one year applies. The code can do either.
issue.acceptance: Logs older than the limit are deleted every night.

issue.title: Fix the off-by-one in pagination
issue.description: The last page repeats the first item of the previous page because the cursor is inclusive. Make the cursor exclusive.
issue.acceptance: Paging through 101 items with a page size of 10 returns every item exactly once; a test covers it.

issue.title: Memory growth in the worker
issue.description: The worker's memory grows over days. It might be the cache or a listener leak; nobody knows yet.
issue.acceptance: Memory stays flat over a week.

cases.why: rests on facts to find out first

issue.title: Bump lodash to 4.17.21
issue.description: Update lodash in package.json and the lock file to 4.17.21.
issue.acceptance: npm ls lodash shows 4.17.21 and the suite passes.

issue.title: Dark mode on the settings page
issue.description: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page that switches the theme.

issue.title: Split the monolith into services
issue.description: Split the app into auth, billing, catalog and orders services, each with its own database.
issue.acceptance: Each service deploys on its own.
